_comment: The config half of the case, frozen from the run that produced the baseline beats.json (video vid_4d5de5a2e04d). A case is only reproducible if the style pack and channel rules it was scored under are pinned beside the script: overlays.density and overlays.emphasis decide how many graphics are even legal, so a case re-run under a different pack is a different question.
